title: SAP Support Analytics — Power BI
shortDescription: Power BI analytics across 11 companies, covering SAP support ticket, workload, problem, recurrence, resolution, and process data.
businessContext: The analysis covers data from 11 companies.
challenge: Provide visibility across ticket volumes, workload, recurring problems, critical issues, and process improvement or automation opportunities.
solution: A Power BI analytics project bringing together ticket, workload, problem, recurrence, resolution, and process data.
impact: Provides visibility into ticket volumes, workload, recurring problems, critical issues, and process improvement and automation opportunities.
